SELECT p.prd_cd, p.prd_nm, p.prd_sp, l.lev_nm, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.clr_nm ORDER BY o.clr_nm ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS colors, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.cod_nm ORDER BY c.cod_nm ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS sizes, SUM(o.prd_qt) AS total_stock, p.prd_dt FROM products p JOIN level l ON p.prd_ca = l.lev_cd INNER JOIN options o ON p.prd_cd = o.prd_cd JOIN common_detailcode c ON o.siz_nm = c.cod_cd WHERE 1=1
AND p.prd_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.prd_nm}, '%')
AND l.lev_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.prd_ca}, '%')
AND o.clr_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.clr_nm}, '%')
AND o.siz_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.siz_nm}, '%')
GROUP BY p.prd_cd, p.prd_nm, p.prd_sp, l.lev_nm, p.prd_dt ORDER BY p.prd_dt DESC
LIMIT #{pageList[0]}, #{pageList[1]}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p INNER JOIN options o ON p.prd_cd = o.prd_cd WHERE 1=1
AND p.prd_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.prd_nm}, '%')
AND p.prd_ca LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.prd_ca}, '%')
AND o.clr_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.clr_nm}, '%')
AND o.siz_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.siz_nm}, '%')

SELECT o.ord_id, -- 주문ID o.ord_at, -- 주문일자 b.buy_nm, -- 구매자명 b.buy_ph, -- 연락처 d.odd_qt, -- 구매수량 d.odd_am, -- 결제금액 CASE d.odd_st WHEN '0' THEN '배송대기' WHEN '1' THEN '배송중' WHEN '2' THEN '배송완료' WHEN '3' THEN '취소접수' WHEN '4' THEN '반품접수' ELSE d.odd_st END AS odd_st -- 변환된 주문상태 FROM orders o JOIN buyers b ON o.buy_em = b.buy_em JOIN order_details d ON o.ord_id = d.ord_id WHERE 1=1
AND o.ord_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.ord_id}, '%')
AND o.ord_at LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.ord_at}, '%')
AND b.buy_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.buy_nm}, '%')
AND b.buy_ph LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.buy_ph}, '%')
AND d.odd_qt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.odd_qt}, '%')
AND d.odd_am LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.odd_am}, '%')
AND d.odd_st LIKE CONCAT('%', #{map.odd_st}, '%')
ORDER BY o.ord_at DESC
LIMIT #{pageList[0]}, #{pageList[1]}
